TileStructure.Forest.𝔖₀.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space, $a$ a natural number, $q$ a real number, $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and $F, G \subseteq X$, satisfying the standing assumptions `ProofData`, and suppose $X$ carries a tile structure (`TileStructure`) with respect to $Q$ and the default parameters `defaultD a`, `defaultκ a`, `defaultS X` and `cancelPt X`. For a natural number $n$, a forest $t$ of level $n$ (`Forest X n`) and tiles $u_1, u_2 \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$, $\mathfrak{S}_0(u_1, u_2)$ is a set of tiles in $\mathfrak{P}(X)$. According to its docstring, it is the set $\mathfrak{S}$ defined in the proof of Lemma 7.4.4 (with subscript $0$ added to distinguish it from a section variable).
